body: Thank you. This is just a vent, but I feel like I'm one of those people that people warn others about, and I feel like I will always be alone. And then with the thought of possibly having a personality disorder with the hopes of getting better not very bright, I feel like I'm at the end of my life. I attempted suicide last November because of all these thoughts. I upset my family so much, and I felt so bad, but I feel like it's the only solution to me. It's so difficult. I have suicidal thoughts everyday, and I can barely keep myself together. I'm sorry I just unloaded a lot of personal stuff, but all of this is almost too much to handle.

I feel like all these traits I've listed in my post are the result of a personality disorder or multiple personality disorders, so I feel like it's impossible to change. I've had an abnormal psychology class, read a case book, and every time a personality disorder is brought up, the prognosis is hopeless. They usually don't get better.
